push_to_talk_then_review_the_transcript_: Push to talk, then review the transcript. Your device’s recognition provider may use the network. PrepTrove does not save audio. English commands are available in this preview.
no_account_ads_analytics_location_tracki: No account, ads, analytics, location tracking or automatic uploads. Records are stored in this app’s private device storage. Device encryption depends on your device settings.
interface_english_preview_other_language: Interface: English preview. Other languages are pending translation and review. Voice and speech capabilities depend on installed device services.
reminders_are_checked_periodically_usual: Reminders are checked periodically, usually daily. Timing is controlled by the operating system. Mark complete to pause; edit the date to snooze.
exports_are_unencrypted_review_the_inclu: PDF, CSV and JSON exports are unencrypted. PTB backups use password-protected encryption. Review the included information before saving.
this_cannot_be_undone_supplies_in_a_dele: This cannot be undone. Supplies in a deleted kit will become unassigned.
all_kits_supplies_contacts_plans_reminde: All kits, supplies, contacts, plans, reminders and checklist tasks will be permanently removed from this device.
also_include_contacts_and_family_plans_3: Also include contacts and family plans
prepared_today_ready_for_tomorrow_your_r: Prepared today. Ready for tomorrow. Your records stay on this device. Interface language: English preview.
reminders_and_microphone_access_are_opti: Reminders and microphone access are optional and requested only when you enable them.
